happy new year from Senso-Ji, Tokyo’s oldest Buddhist temple 🏯

on nye, the temple’s bell joyanokane ring 108 times to drive away the 108 earthly temptations

here’s to a beautiful 2024 https://t.co/fDaEURoYpE

while i’m glad the tech world is now embracing defense tech as a necessity…

it’s late.

2 hot wars. 500k dead in the Ukraine war. instability is dramatically rising

defense tech is meant to deter war, but we’ve crossed the rubicon

we need to now make up for lost time & build

one reason why math can be better for your brain than coding:

coding is constrained in instantiating the imminently possible, thereby limiting the scale & abstraction of thought

math forces you to think about the limits of human thought (ex: cardinalities of infinity)

@alexschultz i’m bucketing that into “tried to be cool” and “traveled” 😂

but yes some glaring omissions
@shaunmmaguire current reading material https://t.co/dXy4OpUvKh

my interests roughly by age

0-12—math+chess all the time
13-17—math+algos+physics all the time
17-25—stopped doing math. tried to be cool. coded, read literature, played poker, traveled, went to concerts/parties
25+—math all the time

as I tell my nephew, math will set you free

just showed my niece (2) and nephew (7) a DALL-E 3 portrait and @suno_ai_ AI-generated songs & they were ~mildly impressed

kids will grow up with AI as a normal, non-mindblowing feature of computers—they won’t know anything about this awkward period of unintelligent computers

RT @lin_zagorski: 2023 was a big year for AI. Here are some highlights of the awesome work done by the @scale_AI brand experience team this…

congratulations to @sundarpichai @demishassabis and the whole @GoogleDeepMind team on Gemini 1.0!

MMLU of 90% is impressive 💥

if the benchmarks hold in use and application of the models, this is pretty groundbreaking. https://t.co/s0IimGcIwt

Read more about the architecture and try it out below:

https://t.co/8zAv2Qywus https://t.co/zDkkeeMV4v

And it is SOTA.

Produces state-of-the-art results on CityScapes and BDD across all tasks. https://t.co/dFMXMa7R7F

It is a foundation model that can solve many relevant perception tasks for autonomy.

It is not task specific nor class specific, so you can use it to recognize an arbitrary taxonomy. https://t.co/0gED7sgLtW

Scale is launching our Automotive Foundation Model, AFM-1.

It is a SOTA language-grounded perception model for autonomous vehicles.

This builds on nearly a decade of @scale_AI technical expertise working at the forefront of autonomy.

https://t.co/8zAv2Qywus https://t.co/XrVcKOjex7 https://t.co/0jazVqrJ4p

.@scale_AI worked with @nvidia on HelpSteer, a first-of-kind multi-attribute preference dataset across correctness, coherence, complexity & verbosity.

We look forward to more research collaboration with @nvidia on LLMs!

Check out the paper here: https://t.co/0ir8grLcJ5 https://t.co/xI5nsW18z2 https://t.co/Odnk4rri4u

perhaps the largest startup arbitrage in the ai world today:

- risk-seeking behavior (startups) vs risk aversion (big cos)

because there’s huge unknowns in the future of AI (copyrights, market structure, product types, etc), willingness to take on risk will reap massive rewards

But actually, here’s the link to the wonderful video:

https://t.co/Ut8K36DfJ2

.@karpathy just published a wonderful video as an introduction to LLMs.

Go watch it if you’re bored on thanksgiving!

ICYMI, he used ChatGPT to definitively determine @scale_AI is worth $150B today and $2T in 2 years

The AI does not lie 🤷 https://t.co/GfqbgvlxFB https://t.co/0385WZMdHZ

I’m excited to see @sama, @gdb and the gang back together at @OpenAI.

They have undeniably changed the world over the past year, and I expect them to continue setting an impressive pace in AI for building, shipping, and innovating on safety.

Nature has healed 🍁
RT @summeryue0: I’m joining Scale and we are starting a new safety lab! Hiring researchers interested in trustworthy evaluations, red teami…
🙏🫡 I have lots to learn from you and @sama! https://t.co/TQRI9evpd9

Read more on forbes:

https://t.co/SxdKMX1sqE

We @scale_AI are starting SEAL: a new frontier safety lab led by @summeryue0—prev Bard RLHF lead at DeepMind.

We plan to do frontier research in trustworthy evaluations, red teaming & scalable oversight; and collaborate w/AI labs & governments closely.

https://t.co/Ingd76fbiM

@paulg direct access/interface to an AI model (ChatGPT) is the fastest growing consumer product ever. that is mind-bending

everything up until now has been prelude—humans have always been fascinated by AI, and now the AI are good enough to take hold of our interest and never let go

more has happened in the last year of AI than the prior 10

we are unmistakably in the fiery takeoff of the most important technology of the rest of our lives

everybody—governments, citizens, technologists—is awaiting w/bated breath (some helplessly) the next version of humanity
